name: Visa photos & biometrics prep (category guide)
summary: ICA / MOM / embassy photo specs vs mall booth luck — digital upload failures, FIN card photo reuse myths, and what ‘biometrics’ actually means at issuance.
body: Pass and ICA photo rejects are a quiet first-month tax: wrong pixel size, glasses glare, white-background fails, or a phone crop that looked fine on WhatsApp. Use a shop that still prints and exports the exact ICA/MOM/embassy spec you need — keep the digital file, not only the print. Your EP/DP card photo is not a universal reusable asset for every embassy visa or PR upload. ‘Biometrics’ at MOM/ICA issuance usually means fingerprints and a live capture at the appointment — a studio photo does not skip that step. Notary/apostille shops sometimes offer photos as an add-on; that does not make them document lawyers. Pair with first-week and passport/document guides. Category guide, not a ranked photo-booth list.
